about: How far (voxels) each avatar slot's faces sit outside the voxel grid planes they were built on. Parts that cover one another (tops over bottoms at the waist, a face on the head, headwear over hair) then never share a plane, so they cannot z-fight: an outer slot has the larger value. Pirate Nation parts lie on the grid (0) or 0.1 voxel off it, so no value here is near those. blender/rig.py grows each RUN part by its layer; the validator checks it (avatar.layers).
